description: zlib compression library - prebuilt with MSVC. Ships shared + static libs and a LuaRocks-compatible static prefix.
notes: Prebuilt on a GitHub runner from the official zlib source release - no CMake or MSVC needed to install this.
See .github/workflows/build-zlib.yml in this repository for exactly how these binaries were produced.
static\lib\zlib.lib  copy of libzs.lib under the name LuaRocks/autotools ask for
Point CMake at the prefix itself (ZLIB_ROOT=<dir>).
Point LuaRocks at the static view (ZLIB_DIR=<dir>\static) - that links the static
library and needs no runtime DLL, which is what lua-zlib and zipwriter want.
